review.assessment: This change adds a new solution.ts file containing only a naive character-for-character reversal implementation. It completely ignores the task requirements to strip non-alphanumeric characters and normalize case before comparing strings. As a result, the change fails to fix the function and instead persists the exact behavior described as broken in the prompt.

findings.call: node -e "console.log(require('./solution').isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama'))"
findings.defect: The function still performs raw string reversal without filtering spaces/punctuation or lowercasing the input. This causes standard palindrome phrases to incorrectly return false instead of true.
